project_info.theme: Toyota Yaris Cross first-half 2026 sales milestone
project_info.color_palette: Bright yellow, coral red, royal blue, green, white

main_subject.detail: A celebratory automotive sales poster with Toyota logo at top left and the line 'DOANH SO 6 THANG DAU NAM 2026'. The centerpiece is an oversized red number '7,962' behind a red Toyota Yaris Cross viewed from a high front three-quarter angle. Large text below reads 'YARIS CROSS DOANH SO THANG HOA TIEP DA LINH HOAT'. At the bottom are four offer boxes: 'UU DAI TUONG DUONG 50 TRIEU DONG', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT CHI TU 7.75%', 'TRA TRUOC 0 DONG', and 'BAO HANH XE VA AC QUY DIEN HYBRID LEN DEN 10 NAM HOAC 185.000 KM (*)'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Bold celebratory sales poster with oversized numerical typography, glossy product hero shot, and bright campaign gradients

Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact line 'DOANH SO 6 THANG DAU NAM 2026', title 'YARIS CROSS DOANH SO THANG HOA TIEP DA LINH HOAT', and bottom offer boxes including '50 TRIEU DONG', '7.75%', '0 DONG', and '10 NAM HOAC 185.000 KM'.
